# Interpolation models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

10 interpolation models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: two RGB images (consecutive frames). Output: the frame between them at `timestep` (0.5 by default; 0 = the first, 1 = the second), RGB in [0, 1].

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial | kernels time (ms),<br>speed-up vs original | kernels peak memory (MiB, reserved),<br>ratio to original |

## EMA-VFI

EMA-VFI (Zhang et al., CVPR 2023; large and small, for the middle frame or any time): makes the frame between two video frames from motion and appearance features that inter-frame attention extracts together, for slow motion and higher frame rates. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ema-vfi` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 296<br>234<br>207 | 3940 / 4290<br>2827 / 3204<br>3129 / 4152 |
| `ema-vfi-small` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 121<br>89.5<br>84.5 | 2272 / 2384<br>1614 / 1792<br>1660 / 2178 |
| `ema-vfi-t` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 287<br>233<br>207 | 3940 / 4290<br>2827 / 3184<br>3129 / 4152 |
| `ema-vfi-small-t` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 114<br>89.4<br>84.5 | 2272 / 2384<br>1614 / 1792<br>1660 / 2178 |

## FILM

FILM (Reda et al., Google, ECCV 2022): makes the middle frame between two video frames, also for large motion, from a flow pyramid in both directions and features shared across scales. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `film` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 464<br>528<br>444 | 2953 / 3556<br>4747 / 5078<br>4763 / 6188 |

## GIMM-VFI

GIMM-VFI (GIMM-VFI-R and its perceptual GIMM-VFI-R-P, Guo et al., NeurIPS 2024): makes the frame at any time between two video frames from a learned continuous motion field (RAFT flow), for slow motion and higher frame rates. Non-commercial code and weights (S-Lab License 1.0).

Commercial use: **no** (code: LicenseRef-noncommercial (noncommercial); weights: LicenseRef-noncommercial).

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gimm-vfi-r` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | OOM<br>2791<br>1695 | –<br>13698 / 15340<br>7860 / 8942 |
| `gimm-vfi-r-p` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | OOM<br>2797<br>1695 | –<br>13698 / 15180<br>7860 / 8882 |

## RIFE

RIFE (Practical-RIFE 4.25, 4.26 and 4.25 lite, Huang et al.): makes the frame between two video frames from the optical flow it estimates between them, for slow motion and higher frame rates. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rife-4.25` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 24.5<br>25.0<br>21.5<br>44.9<br>17.6 | 987 / 1154<br>755 / 894<br>967 / 1076<br>1094 / 1234<br>696 / 714 |
| `rife-4.26` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 24.2<br>25.1<br>21.4<br>44.5<br>17.6 | 1004 / 1154<br>755 / 896<br>967 / 1076<br>1094 / 1234<br>696 / 714 |
| `rife-4.25-lite` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 21.3<br>21.1<br>18.3<br>42.3<br>14.1 | 1012 / 1214<br>754 / 854<br>950 / 1056<br>1061 / 1374<br>696 / 714 |
